messages:
Rita M.: Proposal: run a compact integration test with two ISVs + one HW gateway to validate marketplace install, LangChain orchestration, and LlamaIndex cold-start. Aim for a small public demo after partner approvals.
Diego P.: Which partners?
Rita M.: ISVs: NoteNest and QueryCraft. Gateway/HW: NebulaEdge adapter.
Hannah L.: OK. Must cover AWS Marketplace one-click, helm fallback, and OIDC SSO. Also ensure billing headers propagate: `x-rw-org-id` and `x-rw-request-id`.
Marco S.: I'll prepare a demo repo skeleton: `/helm`, `/adapters/nebula/`, `/e2e/run.sh`. Example: `./e2e/run.sh --provider aws --check-latency`.
Rita M.: Success criteria: 1) install completes without manual creds, 2) median simple query <700ms, 3) billing event appears in usage logs within 2m.
Diego P.: Perf gates sound right. Add KV cache check: second query should show cache hit >65%.
Hannah L.: Legal note: need partner sign-off on co-marketing assets and NebulaEdge SOW update for logo use. Expect ~4 business days.
Marco S.: Infra: will use dedicated staging in us-west-2. I'll create short-lived tokens for demo and document rotation in README.
Rita M.: Timeline: partner NDAs + perms by Thu, repo + infra Fri, dry-run Mon, taped rehearsal Wed.
Diego P.: I'll reach out to NoteNest/QueryCraft PMs to confirm.
LegalBot: Created checklist: NDA circulation, co-marketing approval, SOW addendum. Assigned to Hannah L.
Hannah L.: Confirmed. I'll own legal comms and asset approvals.
Marco S.: I'll seed repo today and add basic LangChain YAML to exercise tool-calling and LlamaIndex bootstrap.
Rita M.: Owners: Rita (program), Marco (repo & infra), Hannah (legal), Diego (partner PM). Confirm?
Diego P.: Confirmed.
Marco S.: Confirmed.
Hannah L.: Confirmed.
Rita M.: I'll schedule a 30-min dry-run next Mon 09:00 PT and share repo link when ready.
